external_entities.name: developer
external_entities.description: A developer who pushes branches to the self-hosted git server and can manually start a rebuild of main.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Developers push their branches to our self-hosted git server
external_entities.notes: Any developer can log in to the build runner and kick off a rebuild of main by hand.

external_entities.name: public package registry
external_entities.description: The public package registry reached during dependency resolution.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Dependency resolution reaches out to the public package registry on the internet

processes.name: build runner
processes.description: Picks up merges, fetches source, resolves the dependency lockfile, produces container images, pushes images to the registry, and calls the deploy controller.
processes.source_excerpt: The build runner picks the merge up, fetches the source, resolves the dependency lockfile and produces a container image.
processes.notes: The runner uses a shared build token to call the deploy controller. It does not verify signatures on downloads from the public package registry.

processes.name: deploy controller
processes.description: Maintains the current release image SHA for the estate and responds to store server release queries.
processes.source_excerpt: The deploy controller runs on the corporate network and holds one record: which image sha the estate should be on.
processes.notes: The runner's token is a shared build token, the same for every pipeline, and has not been rotated since the pipeline was set up.

processes.name: till software
processes.description: Till software running as a container on the small server in each store back office.
processes.source_excerpt: Each store has a small server in the back office running the till software as a container.
processes.notes: The estate contains about 1,200 store servers. Store servers ask the deploy controller for the current release and pull images when their release differs.

data_stores.name: self-hosted git server
data_stores.description: Git server receiving developer branches and providing source to the build runner.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Developers push their branches to our self-hosted git server
data_stores.notes: Nobody has documented whether the git server encrypts what it stores.

data_stores.name: image registry
data_stores.description: Registry storing finished container images tagged with commit SHAs and serving them to store servers.
data_stores.source_excerpt: It pushes the finished image to our image registry, which is also in the build environment.
data_stores.notes: The registry allows the pull; nobody has written down what a store server presents to it. Nobody has documented whether the image registry encrypts what it stores.

data_flows.name: push branches
data_flows.description: Developer pushes branches to the self-hosted git server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Developers push their branches to our self-hosted git server

data_flows.name: fetch source
data_flows.description: The build runner fetches source from the self-hosted git server after a merge.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The build runner picks the merge up, fetches the source
data_flows.notes: A merge to main starts a build.

data_flows.name: resolve dependencies
data_flows.description: The build runner reaches out to the public package registry during dependency resolution.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Dependency resolution reaches out to the public package registry on the internet
data_flows.notes: The runner does not verify signatures on what it downloads.

data_flows.name: push image
data_flows.description: The build runner pushes the finished container image to the image registry.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It pushes the finished image to our image registry
data_flows.notes: Images are tagged with the commit sha.
data_flows.data_description: finished container image tagged with the commit SHA

data_flows.name: set current release
data_flows.description: The build runner asks the deploy controller to make an image the current release.
data_flows.source_excerpt: When the image is pushed the runner calls the deploy controller and asks it to make that image the current release.
data_flows.notes: The token is a shared build token that is the same for every pipeline and has not been rotated since the pipeline was set up.

data_flows.name: query release
data_flows.description: Store servers ask the deploy controller what the current release is.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every store server asks the deploy controller once a minute what the current release is
data_flows.notes: Nobody has written down what a store server presents to the controller.

data_flows.name: pull image
data_flows.description: A store server pulls the current image from the image registry when its running release differs.
data_flows.source_excerpt: if it differs from what it is running it pulls that image from the registry
data_flows.notes: The registry allows the pull; nobody has written down what a store server presents to it.

data_flows.name: kick off rebuild
data_flows.description: A developer logs in to the build runner and manually starts a rebuild of main.
data_flows.source_excerpt: any developer can log in to the build runner and kick off a rebuild of `main` by hand
data_flows.notes: This path does not require a merge and is not reviewed.
